$comment: Single source of truth for the help/user-guide STRUCTURE, shared by two front-ends: the in-app help at /-/docs (web/src/help/topics.ts) and the public docs site's 'User guide' pages (docs-site/scripts/generate.mjs). Prose lives in ./content/<slug>.md; each topic's TITLE is that file's H1 and is never repeated here. Only what lives outside the prose is here: the section grouping, the order, and the one-line summary the topic list shows. Add a topic by adding its slug+summary here and a ./content/<slug>.md file — both front-ends pick it up, and the generator fails the build if the two ever disagree.

topics.summary: Spaces, pages, writing and finding things.
The parts of a marking, which of them decide who may read a page, and why a page shows as (protected).
The tree, labels, icons, properties and trash.
Following pages and being told when they change.
Settings, access and role grants, restrictions, trash and analytics.
Analytics, audit, vocabularies, sync — and what admin does not grant.
